item.tib: zhi khro rdzu 'phrul dra ba dbal chen po gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las bsad pa mtshon cha 'khor lo
item.coloph: khro bo gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyis (gyi) rgyud las/ gsad (bsad) pa mtshon cha'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ stag la me 'bar gyis (gyi) phyag cha rdzogs so/ dge legs 'phel zhing 'gro la phan thog shog/
